name: Indian Food VFM Benchmark
description: Archived release accompanying the manuscript "A Size- and Class-Distribution-Matched Indian Food Benchmark Reveals a Zero-Shot Recognition Gap in Vision Foundation Models". Contents: notebooks/: all notebooks used to produce the reported results (de-duplication and group-aware 70/15/15 splitting, zero-shot evaluation of CLIP ViT-B/32, CLIP ViT-L/14, SigLIP SO400M/14 and SigLIP2 ViT-B/16, linear probes, multi-seed training of DINOv2 with LoRA, linear probe and full fine-tuning, statistics, robustness and Grad-CAM) CompressedDataset/: the 100-class Indian food image benchmark (4,578 collected images; 4,483 retained after duplicate removal) repro_package/: files for reproducing the reported results legacy_original_submission/: materials from the original submission Authors: Swati Shinde, Sneha Attarde, Khushi Dudhalkar, Ritul Aloorkar, Deepali Nilesh Naik, Tanupriya Choudhury.
